title: BJP holds Save Democracy padayatra in Nirmal

tea.why: Protesting against opposition criticism and protests regarding the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls.
tea.want: Support for clean electoral rolls and the removal of illegal infiltrators and duplicate voters.
tea.changed: Nov 3, 2026: BJP leaders led a padayatra in Nirmal to counter opposition propaganda against electoral roll revision.

summary: On November 3, 2026, the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) organised a Save Democracy padayatra in Nirmal town, Telangana, to counter the opposition's campaign against the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls. Led by senior party figures including Union Minister of State for Home Bandi Sanjay Kumar, Telangana state president N. Ramachander Rao, National General Secretary Sunil Bansal, Nirmal MLA Maheshwar Reddy, and MP Etela Rajender, party workers marched from Shanthinagar Chowrasta to Vivek Chowrasta. The leaders defended the electoral roll revision, stating it targets deceased individuals, duplicate voters, and illegal immigrants, while criticizing the Congress party and the INDIA bloc for opposing the process.
demands: Remove illegal infiltrators and duplicate voters from electoral rolls
Support clean electoral rolls through the Special Intensive Revision
response: No official response reported from targeted opposition parties in the sources other than political counter-criticism.
